# Product Brief

## Status

Discovery baseline and approved corrections recorded by the project owner. This document is a foundation for review, not authorization to implement.

## Product

A modern, premium developer portfolio for Wisal Ahmad, positioned as:

> Full-Stack Developer | AI Integration

The portfolio should demonstrate practical full-stack software engineering and AI integration experience together. It should be technically credible, distinctive, accessible, fast, maintainable, and suitable for international audiences.

## Audiences

- International recruiters evaluating fit and credibility.
- Engineering managers evaluating technical depth and communication.
- Potential collaborators evaluating interests, experience, and ways to connect.

## Goals

1. Make Wisal's identity, role, location, and strongest experience clear within the initial page view.
2. Present TaskConnect as the primary featured project with an evidence-based case study.
3. Present professional and internship experience accurately without exposing confidential information.
4. Make individual contribution and team contribution visibly distinct.
5. Support adding projects through data rather than rewriting presentation components.
6. Provide meaningful navigation to projects, experience, GitHub, LinkedIn, and future email/CV links.
7. Establish measurable standards for accessibility, performance, SEO, security, testing, and deployment before implementation.

## First-release scope

- Home
- Projects archive
- Individual project case study routes, initially for TaskConnect
- About and experience
- Contact
- Optional Techora project only after verification and a deliberate inclusion decision

## Content baseline

### Identity

- Name: Wisal Ahmad
- Role: Full-Stack Developer | AI Integration
- Location: Islamabad / Rawalpindi, Pakistan
- GitHub: https://github.com/ahmad-wisal/
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/wisal-ahmad-17aab824/
- Public email: omitted for now
- Public CV URL: omitted for now

### Content boundaries

- TaskConnect is a completed team-based final-year project; Wisal primarily contributed to backend development and application feature integrations as part of a three-person team.
- Systems Limited is a Full Stack Developer Intern experience from July 2025 to August 2025 in Islamabad, Pakistan.
- InternCraft is a Front-End Web Development Intern experience from June 2024 to August 2024.
- Techora is a possible secondary personal/course-related project and is not guaranteed for the first release.
- Features, technologies, links, screenshots, deployment state, achievements, metrics, and professional claims must be verified before publication.

## Non-goals

- No CMS, database, authentication system, or unnecessary backend service.
- No first-release contact form or contact-submission backend.
- No first-release analytics, tracking cookies, or unnecessary third-party embeds.
- No invented metrics, client names, testimonials, user counts, business results, or ownership claims.
- No publication of confidential internship materials.
- No assumption that an academic project is a commercial or production system.
- No additional pages unless they provide clear user value.
- Starter branding, default assets, and placeholder metadata must be removed or replaced before release.

## Experience principles

- Content accuracy takes priority over visual impact.
- Technical detail should explain decisions and evidence, not imply unsupported expertise.
- Every visible link and button must have a meaningful destination or action.
- Server-rendered content is the default.
- Interaction and motion must support comprehension and remain usable with reduced motion enabled.

## Success criteria

The release is successful when:

- All published claims have a confirmed source and approved publication status; unverified claims are omitted from public rendering.
- A visitor can reach the featured project, archive, experience, and contact paths from the primary navigation.
- The TaskConnect case study distinguishes Wisal's work from team functionality.
- The site works at supported mobile, tablet, and desktop widths without horizontal scrolling.
- Automated lint, type-check, build, accessibility, link, and metadata checks defined in the quality specification pass.
- No first-release feature requires a database, authentication, or contact backend.
- Only content explicitly marked approved for publication may render publicly.

## Open questions and verification tasks

- Verify TaskConnect repository technologies, implemented features, and current deployment state.
- Verify public TaskConnect repository/deployment links before publishing them.
- Verify assignment-specific Systems Limited technologies and permissible descriptions.
- Verify whether InternCraft demonstrations remain accessible.
- Verify Techora implementation, public links, and whether it strengthens the release.
- Decide the final public email and CV URL when available.
- Decide the production hosting platform and domain.
- Define supported browsers/devices and exact performance budgets during technical review.
